report.summary: All four UI tests fail on a 5-second timeout while waiting for /books or the post-register redirect to finish loading. The app's list_books() sleeps a random 0-8 seconds on every books-page render (app/main.py:149-150), so whether a run passes is down to chance. Fix this first by removing or gating that sleep in the app, which makes these four tests deterministic again.

causes.title: Books page render sleeps a random 0-8 s, exceeding the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: app/main.py:149-150 calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) at the start of list_books(). render_books() (app/main.py:256) calls list_books() on every /books render, and the register POST redirects to /books (app/main.py:297). tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7 sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms. Page.goto waits for the 'load' event and Locator.click waits for the resulting navigation, so any sleep above roughly 5 s times out. By the uniform distribution that happens about 3/8 of the time per render, so the same code can pass on a rerun. The product is not wrong on every run; it is just sometimes slow, which makes these tests flaky. The first three tests fail inside Page.goto('/books') before any test logic runs, and the login test fails on the click that triggers the redirect to /books. Nothing in the assertions was reached in any of the four.
evidence: tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:10 (test_added_book_is_listed): books = BooksPage(logged_in_page).open() -> Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load"
tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:23 (test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui): Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded, navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63060/books", waiting until "load"
tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:39 (test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input): Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded, navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load"

tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:9 (test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf): Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (click on get_by_test_id("submit") after POST /register, which redirects to /books)
app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]:\n    time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:250-258 render_books() calls list_books(user["id"]) on every /books render; app/main.py:297 register redirects to /books
tests/conftest.py:31-42 and tests/support/pages.py:33-35 show the tests have no other delay source; the only sleep on the request path is the app's
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from list_books() in app/main.py. If a slow-path test is needed, put the delay behind an explicit setting that is off by default and never set in CI, or move it into a dedicated test that sets its own timeout. Do not raise the 5 s timeout in tests/ui/conftest.py to hide it; that only makes the suite slower. After the fix, rerun the UI suite a few times to confirm it is stable.
